name: doc_parsing
description: Reads a provided document (PDF, Word, TXT) and converts its contents into a Markdown string for the LLM to read and analyze.

inputs.name: file_path
inputs.description: The absolute or relative path to the document file that needs to be read.

outputs.description: A dictionary containing the status and the extracted 'markdown_content' of the document.

output.markdown_content:
## Document: safety_guidelines.pdf

All lentiviral vectors must be treated as Risk Group 2...
